events.title: Nhu Check-out of hotel in Zhongli
events.desc: Prepare to travel to Taichung. Note: if waiting for Alan, ask hotel to keep luggage after check-out. Possible extra fee (late check-out / luggage service): ~50-200 TWD. Travel note: hotel -> Zhongli Station area is usually about 10-15 min by taxi / 15-25 min on foot depending on luggage.
events.movingTime: 10-25 min from hotel to Zhongli Station area

events.title: Alan landed - Head to Zhongli
events.desc: Airport transfer to Zhongli. Estimated travel time from Taoyuan Airport to Zhongli: about 35-50 min depending on Airport MRT / taxi combination.
events.movingTime: 35-50 min from Taoyuan Airport to Zhongli

events.title: Pick up Alan & Lunch
events.desc: Pick up Alan at MRT Taoyuan Zhongli Station. Lunch estimate: ~120-250 TWD/person (plus drinks/snacks ~30-80 TWD). Travel note: Zhongli Station lunch spot -> TRA Zhongli Station is about 10-15 min by taxi or 15-20 min on foot.
events.movingTime: 10-20 min from lunch area to TRA Zhongli Station

events.title: Head to Train Station & Travel to Taichung
events.desc: Take an Uber (~100 TWD) to TRA Zhongli station. Take a train from Zhongli to Taichung. Estimated travel time: 10-15 min to station + around 1 hr 40 min to 2 hr 10 min by TRA depending on train type, then another 10-15 min from Taichung Station to Fooyee hotel. Potential extra costs: Uber surge (~120-180 TWD), train type upgrade, and light food/water at station.
events.movingTime: 10-15 min + 1h40-2h10 + 10-15 min (to station, train, to hotel)

events.title: Check-in Hotel in Taichung - 3 nights
events.desc: Fooyee hotel (4940/2). Travel note: Taichung Station -> hotel is usually around 10-15 min by taxi or 15-20 min on foot with luggage.
events.movingTime: 10-20 min from Taichung Station to hotel

events.title: Rainbow Village
events.desc: Visit the painted village (free entry). From Fooyee hotel / Taichung Station area, travel time is about 25-35 min by car or 40-55 min by bus. Transport note: budget local bus/Uber split around 60-120 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 25-55 min from Taichung Station / Fooyee area

events.title: National Taiwan Museum of Comics
events.desc: Free entry. Travel note: Rainbow Village -> Museum of Comics is about 20-30 min by car or 35-50 min by bus. Add transport + drink break budget around 30-80 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 20-50 min from Rainbow Village
events.query: National Taiwan Museum of Comics Taichung

events.title: National Museum of Natural Science
events.desc: Student ticket 90 NTD. Traveler/adult galleries ticket 120 NTD. Travel note: Museum of Comics -> Natural Science Museum is about 10-15 min by car or 20-25 min by bus.
events.movingTime: 10-25 min from Museum of Comics
events.query: National Museum of Natural Science Taichung

events.title: Sunset viewing at Gaomei Wetland
events.desc: Best sunset spot in Taichung. Travel note: Natural Science Museum area -> Gaomei Wetland is usually 50-70 min by car or 80-100 min by public transport. Transport note: round-trip bus/train or taxi split often 150-300 TWD/person depending on departure point/time.
events.movingTime: 50-100 min from Taichung city center

events.title: Mitsui Outlet Park Taichung
events.desc: Shopping, dinner, and relaxing in the evening. Travel note: Gaomei Wetland -> Mitsui Outlet Park is about 20-30 min by car. Suggested food + small shopping buffer: 250-500 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 20-30 min from Gaomei Wetland

events.title: Explore Sun Moon Lake
events.desc: Rent 2 motorbikes to ride around the lake. Estimated rental: 500 TWD/bike/day (2 bikes = 1000 TWD). Add fuel/parking and local transfer to Sun Moon Lake. Travel note: Taichung city -> Sun Moon Lake is about 1 hr 30 min to 2 hr one way depending on bus/car. Practical budget: around 450 TWD/person when split by 4.
events.movingTime: 1h30-2h one way from Taichung to Sun Moon Lake

events.title: Fengchia Night Market
events.desc: Explore Taiwan's largest night market. Travel note: Sun Moon Lake -> Fengchia area can take around 1 hr 30 min to 2 hr back to Taichung, depending on return timing. Suggested dinner/snacks budget: 200-350 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 1h30-2h from Sun Moon Lake back to Fengchia area

events.title: Xinshe Castle & Confucius Temple
events.desc: Visit Xinshe Castle and Taichung Confucius Temple. Confucius Temple is free; Xinshe area and transport can add costs. Travel note: Fooyee hotel / Taichung Station area -> Xinshe is about 40-60 min, then Xinshe -> Confucius Temple area about 25-35 min by car. Suggested budget: 200-300 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 40-60 min to Xinshe, then 25-35 min to Confucius Temple

events.title: Heading to Taipei
events.desc: TRA Train from Taichung to Taipei. Estimated travel time: 10-20 min from sightseeing area back to station + around 2 hr to Taipei Main Station, then another 10-20 min local transfer to hotel. Add station transfer/metro/snacks buffer around 50-100 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 10-20 min + ~2h train + 10-20 min (to station, train, to hotel)

events.title: Taipei Team Evening Itinerary
events.desc: Check in hotel at Taipei + short rest -> Yongkang St food tour + Zhongshan shopping walk. Using Taipei Main Station as base: Taipei Main -> Yongkang Street is around 15-20 min by MRT, then Yongkang -> Zhongshan about 10-15 min. Dinner + drinks + MRT budget: 250-400 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 15-20 min (Taipei Main -> Yongkang), then 10-15 min (Yongkang -> Zhongshan)

events.title: Shifen Old Street & Waterfall
events.desc: Release sky lanterns at Shifen Old Street and visit waterfall. Using Taipei Main Station as base: travel time is about 70-90 min by TRA + local line. Sky lantern + transport estimate: around 180-300 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 70-90 min from Taipei Main Station

events.title: Houtong Cat Village
events.desc: Visit Houtong Cat Village. Travel note: Shifen -> Houtong is usually around 40-50 min by train/transfer. Site is mostly free; reserve 40-80 TWD/person for local train and drinks.
events.movingTime: 40-50 min from Shifen

events.title: Jiufen Old Street
events.desc: Stroll around Jiufen Old Street. Travel note: Houtong -> Jiufen is about 35-50 min depending on train + bus/taxi connection. Plan budget for bus/train transfer + tea/snacks: 150-250 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 35-50 min from Houtong

events.title: Raohe Night Market
events.desc: Dinner at Raohe Night Market. Travel note: Jiufen -> Raohe Night Market is roughly 45-60 min by bus/train. Typical meal + snacks budget: 200-320 TWD/person.
events.movingTime: 45-60 min from Jiufen

events.title: Taipingshan + Luodong Night Market
events.desc: Full-day Yilan plan: Taipei Main Station -> Luodong / Yilan transfer -> Taipingshan National Forest Recreation Area -> Luodong Night Market -> back to Taipei. Travel time is long: Taipei Main -> Luodong about 70-90 min, then Luodong -> Taipingshan about 90-120 min one way. Estimated per person: transport 300-450 TWD + park/activities 150-200 TWD + food 250-350 TWD.
events.movingTime: Taipei Main -> Luodong 70-90 min; Luodong -> Taipingshan 90-120 min (one way)

events.title: Yangmingshan National Park
events.desc: City-nature day in Taipei: hiking/scenic spots in Yangmingshan, then dinner back in city. Using Taipei Main Station as base, travel time is usually around 50-70 min by MRT + bus. Main spots are mostly free. Estimated per person: transport 60-120 TWD + snacks/food 200-350 TWD.
events.movingTime: 50-70 min from Taipei Main Station

events.title: Museum + Taipei 101 + Temples + Astronomy + Shilin
events.desc: National Taiwan Museum + Taipei 101 + Longshan Temple + Wenchang Temple + Taipei Astronomical Museum + Shilin Night Market. Using Taipei Main Station as base: Taipei Main -> National Taiwan Museum 5-10 min, -> Taipei 101 about 15-20 min, -> Longshan Temple about 15-20 min, -> Wenchang Temple / Astronomical Museum area about 20-30 min, then -> Shilin Night Market about 10-15 min. Notes: Longshan/Wenchang are free. Estimated per person: Taipei 101 observatory ~600 TWD (optional), museum/astronomy tickets ~70-120 TWD total, transport ~80-150 TWD, food/night market ~250-350 TWD.
events.movingTime: Most transfers are 10-30 min from Taipei Main Station baseline
events.query: National Taiwan Museum Taipei 101 Longshan Temple Wenchang Temple Taipei Astronomical Museum Shilin Night Market

events.title: Hotel Checkout
events.desc: Check out from Taipei hotel. Travel note: if luggage is left at hotel, allow 10-20 min to return and collect before heading to Taipei Main Station / Zoo.
events.movingTime: 10-20 min buffer for luggage return/collection
35-45 min from Taipei Main Station by MRT
events.title: Taipei Zoo
events.desc: Explore Taipei Zoo. Entry ticket: 92 NTD. Estimated MRT round-trip from Taipei city center: 40-60 NTD/person. Estimated snack/water budget: 80-150 NTD/person.

events.movingTime: 35-45 min to Taipei Main Station before departure
events.title: Nhu travels from Taipei ➔ Hualien
events.desc: Nhu takes train to Hualien. Thu picks up at station. Travel note: Taipei Zoo / city area -> Taipei Main Station usually takes around 35-45 min by MRT, so leave buffer before departure.
